_meta.description: Deterministic legal mapping engine for National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (NCRP) sub-categories to statutory penal provisions.
_meta.primary_cyber_statute: Information Technology Act, 2000 (Act No. 21 of 2000 as amended)
_meta.procedural_statute: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Act No. 46 of 2023)
_meta.source_registry: Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India (India Code Information System: indiacode.nic.in)
_meta.bns_note: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita 2023 replaced the Indian Penal Code (IPC 1860) with effect from 1 July 2024. Legacy IPC equivalents are retained for statutory cross-referencing and historical FIR compatibility.
_meta.evidentiary_note: Section 63 of Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA) 2023 governs admissibility of electronic records in court, superseding legacy Section 65B of Indian Evidence Act 1872.
_meta.disclaimer: This mapping constitutes automated decision-support for investigating officers (IOs) and law enforcement authorities. It does not replace independent judicial or prosecutorial discretion.
